key_terms.البرص: Leprosy (baras), a skin disease; used here to warn against overeating
key_terms.الشبع: Satiety, fullness; being full from eating

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about eating while full?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) warned that eating when already satiated causes leprosy (baras). This hadith, narrated through a chain of Imams going back to Imam Musa al-Kadhim (the 7th Imam), reflects the Islamic emphasis on moderation in eating. In the context of classical Islamic medical and ethical teachings, overeating was considered a source of physical disease and moral laxity.
